output.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This averages item_count (total quantity of units on an order) over completed orders (is_revenue is true) placed in 2025. "Items" means units ordered, not the number of order lines. The result is rounded to 2 decimals.
